secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key (from https://resend.com/api-keys) — used to send verification emails. Optional for dev: without it, codes are returned in the API response instead of being emailed.

secrets.name: RESEND_FROM_EMAIL
secrets.description: From-email address for Resend (e.g. 'WASModrinth <noreply@yourdomain.com>'). Must use a verified domain in Resend. Optional — defaults to Resend's onboarding@resend.dev testing sender.
